cards.text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus, is writing to the saints in Ephesus (Ephesians 1:1). He just prayed they'd know the surpassing greatness of God's power, the same power God used to raise Christ from the dead and seat Him at His right hand (Ephesians 1:19-20). Now Paul turns to his readers and reminds them where they were before all that.

cards.question: Paul tells his readers that back then, they were ___ in their trespasses and sins.

cards.text: Not tired, not hitting snooze, DEAD! And Paul says they used to walk in those sins, following the ways of this world and of the ruler of the power of the air.

cards.question: Paul calls the ruler of the power of the air a spirit. True or false: Paul says that spirit is no longer at work now.

cards.text: Then Paul describes a life of fulfilling the cravings of the flesh and indulging its desires and thoughts. The flesh says "I want it," and the answer is YES, like me left alone with a fresh tub of sprinkles.

cards.question: Paul describes a life of fulfilling the cravings of the flesh. Who does Paul say lived that way at one time?

answers.text: All of us with Paul included

cards.question: True or false: Paul says that by nature, he and his readers were children of wrath, like the rest.

cards.text: Then Paul turns the whole thing around with one little word: "But…" Three letters, friend. THREE. And everything changes.

cards.question: Paul says we were dead in our sins. Why does God step in for us?

answers.text: Because we earned a second chance
Because we finally called out to Him

cards.text: Paul says God is rich in mercy, friend, not a pinch saved for emergencies but RICH! And God made us alive with Christ.

cards.question: Paul says God made him and his readers alive with Christ. When did God do it?

answers.text: Even when they were dead in their trespasses
Once they stopped walking in their sins
After they turned from the ways of this world

cards.text: Then Paul breaks out with a short exclamation. I bet Paul wanted to jump up and down, the way I hop on my gold base when a batch comes out PERFECT.

cards.question: Paul exclaims that it is by ___ you have been saved.
Paul says God made us alive with Christ. He goes on: God raised us up with Christ and ___ us with Him in the heavenly realms.

cards.text: Seated, friend, not hovering by the door hoping somebody saves you a spot. SEATED, in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus!

cards.question: Paul says God made us alive, raised us up and seated us with Christ. Why did God do it, according to Paul?

answers.text: To display the riches of His grace
To display the strength of His people
To display His anger at the world

cards.text: God did all that so that in the coming ages He might display the surpassing riches of His grace, shown in His kindness to us in Christ Jesus. Not a weekend. Not a season. The coming AGES!

cards.question: Paul comes back to that grace line from before: it is by grace you have been saved through faith, and this not from yourselves. So what does Paul call it?

cards.text: A gift, friend. I didn't stamp my way out of that junk drawer; the light found me lying under the dust. And Paul says it's not by works.

cards.question: Paul says it's not by works. True or false: Paul says that's so no one can boast.

cards.text: So nobody gets to post "Saved myself, no big deal" in the group chat. Then Paul says we are God's workmanship, created in Christ Jesus.

cards.question: Paul says we are God's workmanship, created in Christ Jesus. What does Paul say we were created to do?

cards.text: Not saved BY works, friend, created FOR good works. One is a ticket you could never afford, and the other is the work you were made to do.

cards.question: Paul says we were created in Christ Jesus to do good works. True or false: Paul says it's up to us to plan those good works ourselves.

cards.text: God prepared them in advance as our way of life, like walking into the bakery and finding the oven already warm. Somebody was expecting you!
